title: Genotype-adaptive regulatory mechanisms of nano-silicon in alleviating cadmium toxicity in pakchoi
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,1641-1652
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01097G, Paper
Kan Huang, Zongfeng Hu, Songwei Wu, Qiling Tan, Chengxiao Hu, Xuecheng Sun
Nano-silicon (Nano-Si) and ionic silicon (Ion-Si) were compared for their capacity to alleviate cadmium (Cd) toxicity in Cd-tolerant (HG) and Cd-sensitive (HXW) pakchoi (Brassica chinensis L.) cultivars under 10 μM Cd stress.
